points.quote: Notice is given under Section 22.2(3) of the Forest and Range Practices Act that the Bonanza FSR (8229.07) is hereby closed at 14.0 km effective immediately until further notice.
This action is in response to the washout of a creek crossing located at 14km posing a safety risk to road users.

map_readings.label: Closure Location
map_readings.shows: A yellow warning-triangle symbol (legend: Closure Location) on the Bonanza FSR line, at the point where the light-blue road line ends and the thick red line begins. No km label is printed at the symbol.

map_readings.label: Bonanza FSR 8229.07
map_readings.shows: The Bonanza FSR is drawn as a thick red line from the Closure Location symbol to the end of the road; the map title reads 'Bonanza FSR 8229.07 CLOSURE'.

map_readings.label: Hangover FSR 8229.06
map_readings.shows: Hangover FSR 8229.06 is drawn as a thin red line, the colour the legend gives to 'Hangover_closure'; an unlabelled road it meets is also drawn red. The notice text does not mention this road.
